title: Device agent local host crypto submission
description: POST /api/v1/device-interrogation-service/agents/{id}/host-crypto: a LOCAL collection the agent made on its own schedule (setting host_crypto_enabled), which has no job. Sent only when the platform negotiated host_crypto_v1. The report is at most 16 MiB, cut honestly to fit (limit max_result_bytes). A collection the platform asked for is a host_crypto job and returns through /results instead.
